subcategory_text: Audit/log records are determined, documented, implemented, and reviewed in accordance with policy and incorporating the principle of data minimization.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: AU-2 (Auditable Events), AU-6 (Audit Review, Reporting, and Support)
GDPR Art. 5(1)(c) (Data minimisation), Art. 30 (Records of processing)
implementation_examples: Determine, document, implement, and review audit/log records for data-processing activities consistent with policy and data-minimisation principles (least detail, shortest retention needed for the purpose)
Define event coverage, log protection, retention, and review responsibilities
Schedule periodic review by an independent function
assessment_objectives: Determine whether audit/log records for data processing are determined and documented
Determine whether log records implement data-minimisation principles
Determine whether reviews are scheduled and executed
Determine whether logs are protected from tampering
